## Landing map & cross-MMD (mean ± std [median])

*Y-space eval columns (MMD→bi/uni, gen std, frac 2s) are BASIN-LEVEL only: evaluation is seed-paired per restart across arms/conventions, and p(y|x̂) is exactly locally constant deep in a basin (w_C saturates to float 0/1 beyond |x∓2|≈0.3; component means/stds are x-independent), so same-basin landings yield byte-identical eval samples by construction. Within-basin differences live in the x-space columns (|x−x_bi|, |x−x_uni|).*
